text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What Curren Chan was scheming was to 
launch her channel on UmaTube.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, on top of that, she plans 
to actively update other social media 
platforms like Umatter and Umatok, not 
just Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By helping out with her photoshoot, the 
Trainer comes to realize just how tough it 
really is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though her trainer worried about pre-race 
fatigue... Curren Chan brushed all 
concerns aside, dedicating herself wholly 
to spreading cuteness.
